message.content:
It depends on what you’re looking for—genre, critical acclaim, audience reception, etc.—but here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most celebrated films from 2020:

| Rank | Title | Director | Genre | Notable Accolades |
|------|-------|----------|-------|-------------------|
| 1 | *Parasite* (South Korean) | Bong Joon‑ho | Thriller/Drama | Best Picture Oscar (though released in 2019, it dominated 2020 awards season) |
| 2 | *1917* | Sam Mendes | War Drama | Best Cinematography & Best Visual Effects Oscars |
| 3 | *Soul* | Pete Docter | Animated/Fantasy | Best Animated Feature Oscar |
| 4 | *Tenet* | Christopher Nolan | Sci‑Fi Action | Nominated for 5 Oscars, including Best Visual Effects |
| 5 | *The Trial of the Chicago 7* | Aaron Sorkin | Historical Drama | Nominated for 8 Oscars |

If you’re into indie gems, *Nomadland* (Chloé Zhao) and *Minari* (Lee Isaac Chung) were also critically acclaimed and won major awards in 2021. For action lovers, *Extraction* (Chris Hemsworth) and *Sonic the Hedgehog* had strong fan followings.

Let me know if you’d like recommendations tailored to a specific genre or mood!
